title: Putting Standing Travel Credit towards an Air Ticket Fare Brands Itinerary
content:
A traveller holding credit in their own name may put it towards an Air Ticket Fare Brands itinerary they are holding. This is the entry point for that movement.

## 1. The situation this governs

The situation is a traveller who holds standing travel credit and an Air Ticket Fare Brands itinerary to put it towards. The result governed is the value released onto that itinerary, and the effect is a redemption line standing on the itinerary being paid for, with a smaller open travel credit on the booking the voucher was raised on.

## 2. Whose movement it is

Because the credit is the traveller's own property, the movement is not made on their behalf. The tool `apply_travel_credit_e74c9b2a` is unlocked and then handed over to be run by the customer themselves.

## 3. Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| air_booking_id | the internal reference number of the air booking the voucher is spent on, read from the traveller's booking record returned by the booking lookup | an identifier |
| customer_id | the traveller reference number the redemption is recorded against, read from the traveller profile returned by the profile lookup | an identifier |
| credit_voucher_code | the voucher code as it is quoted on the credit the traveller holds, as the booking's credit lines record it | copied character for character, keeping its wording, digits and punctuation, with no translation, normalisation, summarisation, addition or deletion |
| credit_applied_usd | the sum taken off the voucher | USD with exactly 2 decimal places, a positive number, rounded to the nearest cent at the moment it is passed; no empty value and no other currency |
| source_event_id | the reference number of the credit-issue line that carries this voucher, read from that line on the booking's ledger | an identifier |

## 4. What comes back

A plain-language confirmation line naming the reference of the redemption line that was posted, the voucher code it was taken from, the sum applied in USD to two decimal places, and the open travel credit left on the booking the voucher was raised on. The presence of that line reference is what indicates the value moved onto the itinerary; nothing is returned when no redemption line is posted.
